question_text: The national government transfers the responsibility for delivering basic health services to provincial governments, along with the corresponding funding and personnel. At the same time, it sets up regional offices of the Department of Health to oversee compliance with national standards. Which of the following best describes these two processes?

options.text: The first is devolution, and the second is deconcentration.
The first is deconcentration, and the second is devolution.
